_doc: Farm goodies sold in the shop. kind 'food': bought into your pantry, placed on the farm from the tray; sheep within 'attract' (units, scaled with the farm; 0 = whole farm) walk over and eat. 'seats' = how many eat at once, 'amount' = sheep-seconds of eating before it's gone. kind 'toy': lives on the farm; now and then a sheep runs at it and sends it rolling. 'r' = radius, 'bounce' 0..1, 'friction' = how fast it slows. Art: js/art/props.js ITEM_PAINTERS[paint].
